intent: Freeze a reproducible P1 baseline and then test, in declared order, whether bounded dynamic evidence acquisition has real Headroom over the current B1 retrieval path.
assumptions: The P1 requirements package remains READY_FOR_ENGINEERING_HANDOFF and its hashes are recorded by the validator.
P0-B R3 is closed as P0B_PASSED_OWNER_ACCEPTED and its frozen assets remain readable.
The current Python 3.12 uv environment and existing P0 retrieval/answer contracts are the implementation base.
non_goals: B0 Direct Multimodal, VLM, OCR, keyframes, dense/hybrid/reranker retrieval
LangGraph, Hypha, MCP server, multi-agent, database, queue, worker, API, Web/UI, or long-term memory
P0 history repair, selective reruns, formal provider evaluation before explicit authorization, P2/G2 work
stop_rules: Any TASK-P1-000 verification failure stops without changing P0 history.
Owner candidate/Gold freeze is required before TASK-P1-020 and before any B2 prompt/tool design.
Headroom count below two stops as NO_GO_INSUFFICIENT_HEADROOM.
FormalManifest freeze stops as WAITING_OWNER_PROVIDER_AUTHORIZATION until exact Owner authorization.
No automatic entry into P2/G2 or any unlisted adjacent gate.
Candidate/Gold draft material is not frozen until Owner confirms the exact accepted set and Gold mapping.
